investment_strategy: Constructive-but-selective AI-led barbell. Overweight cash-generative software/cloud platforms with clear AI monetization (MSFT, GOOGL) and balance with critical semiconductor enablers (ASML, NVDA) plus a durable on-device AI consumer platform (AAPL). Given VIX ~17 and 10Y ~4.6%, favor quality, profitability, and dominant moats; cap exposure to highest-beta semis to manage drawdown and export-control risk. Stagger entries over 2–4 weeks to smooth volatility and rebalance quarterly around earnings and regulatory milestones.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Quality AI platforms + semiconductor chokepoints with controlled beta; diversified across cloud, consumer on-device, and equipment.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Emphasized lower volatility where available, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, and bullish analyst consensus; sized positions by macro (VIX ~17, 10Y ~4.6%), regulatory/China exposure, and role in AI value chain. Excluded or underweighted names with negative momentum or weaker fundamentals (e.g., QCOM, INTC, high-vol MU).
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Tech leadership persists amid moderate volatility and high but stable rates; AI adoption broadens from cloud to edge with data-center and energy constraints shaping winners. Expect selective outperformance from cash-generative platforms and mission-critical semiconductor enablers; manage antitrust and U.S.-China policy risks through sizing and diversification.
